description: Monthly European natural gas reference price in USD per MMBtu (World Bank series PNGASEUUSDM, via FRED). Not the Dutch TTF hub settlement, day-ahead or storage level; the route name is kept for the owner. Latest value plus up to 24 months of history. Takes about 13 s; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: energy_natural_gas_henry_hub when you need Daily Henry Hub natural gas spot price in USD per MMBtu. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
